verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench ships UI-based web tools (Document Driver, Capital and Liquidation Calculators), so asking whether they can be driven through an API is a fair question. No evidence shows any API exists, and probes for OpenAPI and Swagger specs and for llms.txt all returned 404. With the axis applicable and no documented API, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
